title_en: Official Reply of the Supreme People's Court Concerning Case Jurisdiction Issues of the Hebei Xiong'an New Area Intermediate People's Court and the Grassroots People's Courts Under Its Jurisdiction
keywords_en: intellectual property; cases of the court and its subordinate basic people's courts
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Reply Concerning the Jurisdiction over Cases by the Intermediate People's Court of Xiong'an New Area, Hebei Province, and the Basic People's Courts under Its Jurisdiction

Fa Fa [2019] No. 1

High People's Court of Hebei Province:

Your court's "Request for Instructions Report on the Jurisdiction over Cases by the Intermediate People's Court of Xiong'an New Area, Hebei Province, and the Basic People's Courts under Its Jurisdiction" has been received. Upon study, the reply is as follows:

1. The Intermediate People's Court of Xiong'an New Area has jurisdiction over cases within the scope of Xiong'an New Area and its managed areas (including four townships: Gougezhuang Town, Mozhou Town, and Qijianfang Village in Renqiu City, and Longhua Village in Gaoyang County). Xiong County People's Court has jurisdiction over cases within the original administrative division of Xiong County and Gougezhuang Town, Mozhou Town, and Qijianfang Village in Renqiu City; Anxin County People's Court has jurisdiction over cases within the original administrative division of Anxin County and Longhua Village in Gaoyang County.

2. The Intermediate People's Court of Xiong'an New Area has jurisdiction over first-instance civil and commercial cases with the subject matter in dispute of not less than RMB 30 million but not more than RMB 300 million. Where this Reply is inconsistent with the provisions of the "Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Adjusting the Standards for the Jurisdiction of High People's Courts and Intermediate People's Courts over First-Instance Civil and Commercial Cases" (Fa Fa [2015] No. 7), this Reply shall prevail.

3. Environmental and resource cases (including criminal, civil, and administrative cases) within the surrounding areas of Xiong'an New Area, including the jurisdictions of Shijiazhuang, Baoding, Langfang, and Cangzhou, shall be centrally subject to the jurisdiction of the courts of Xiong'an New Area. The division of jurisdiction over environmental and resource cases by level between the Intermediate People's Court of Xiong'an New Area and the basic people's courts, as well as the scope and types of cases subject to centralized jurisdiction among the basic people's courts, shall be specified in a detailed plan proposed by the High People's Court of Hebei Province, which shall be submitted to the Supreme People's Court for approval.

4. The jurisdiction of the courts of Xiong'an New Area over intellectual property cases and civil and commercial cases involving foreign, Hong Kong, Macao, or Taiwan elements shall be separately provided for.

5. Matters not covered by this Reply shall be handled in accordance with the provisions of relevant laws and judicial interpretations.

January 9, 2019
